question: The ‘Karbi Anglong Agreement’ signed in September 2021 is related to the ethnic community of the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• They prefer to call themselves** Karbi, and **sometimes** Arleng(literally "man" in the Karbi language)**.
 
• Karbi people are the main tribe of** Karbi Anglong **and** West Karbi Anglong **districts of** ******Ass**am**.
 
• As a traditional costume, the Karbi bride-groom wears the **ricong (loin cloth), Choihongthor (sleeveless jacket), and turban (poho)**.
 
• During the marriage, they wear the **white colored poho called poho-ke-lok. **
 
• Nowadays they use cheleng** pekok as dhoti in place of the traditional rickong.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b963b23b81aaee94c3fec62667ae78b55aafecc5a2bcbf874992ec2cf108c4b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In Sikkim,​ **there are three ethnic groups in Sikkim- **Lepchas, Bhutias, and Nepalese**. 
 
• The three ethnic groups of people represent a** synthesis of three diverse cultures, traditions, and religions in Sikkim.**
 
• **The **Seemanchal** region of **Bihar**,** which comprises four districts** - Katihar, Kishanganj, Araria, and Purnea - **has a majority of tribes.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh_**The State has a total of **five (5) Scheduled Tribes** and all of them have been enumerated in the 2011 census. 
 
• The tribal population of the State is predominantly rural with 88.8 percent of them residing in villages.
